How it rates

Good fits come back every period and are mostly reading, comparing, checking, summarizing or drafting. Judgment, exact calculation, other systems and chasing people stay with you. Pattern-based, no AI; it matched careful labeling on 75% of 60 test tasks, not yet measured on real ones. Workiva AI features come from Workiva's support pages (checked 15 Oct 2026). Ones marked “check your entitlement” belong to named Workiva solutions your organization may not have.

Everything on this page runs in your browser. Your tasks and files are not uploaded or sent to any AI service; file readers load from a public CDN only when you add that file type.
